note: Grand Valley RD (GMUG) campground on the Grand Mesa at ~10,100 ft beside Cottonwood Lake #1, reached from Collbran by 58.5/59 Road, then Forest Roads 121 and 257 (~19 miles; the FS calls the directions tricky and suggests calling). Hiking, ATV and jeep roads nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan & Pay listing: confirmed 36 sites, 42-ft max spur, vault toilets, no water or hookups, FCFS, $18 (extra vehicle $9). Season now the FS dates June 26 - Sept 22. 'Site Closed' banner = end of season. Pin = FS point, at the east end of the loops; fine. Waterfront left 'not waterfront' (see flag). Note trimmed of all field facts.
flags: Waterfront unresolved both ways: the pin is ~150 m east of Cottonwood Lake #1's east shore (bare drawdown band at the edge), and the loops run west from it under dense spruce toward the shore; individual sites can't be placed on imagery and recreation.gov has no per-site points. The FS page doesn't mention lake access from the sites. Stored 'not waterfront' kept; a site map or per-site points could show lakeview/lakefront sites at the west end.
Missing phone: Grand Valley Ranger District, (970) 242-8211 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/offices); the FS page asks visitors to call for directions.
Access: ~19 miles from Collbran, the last ~12 on gravel Forest Roads 121 and 257; no 4WD or high-clearance advice found.
